items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: I had a pupil here and she was playing Bach

ctx.x: Is it really possible to shift over to classical music after -

Very possible. I had a pupil here and she was playing Bach and I had to teach her how to memorize and how to really play it. In about 5 minutes I was playing 4 bars. You understand? You know what classical music is - something that somebody's written and you do exercises on it in your woodshed and play it. But jazz is difficult. You think what
